definition: In artificial intelligence and cloud computing, compute is the amount of computing power or computational resources required to train large language models.
details: More broadly, compute is the computational power or resources necessary for a computer or computer program to function.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. And that is Compute (machine learning) — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
